purpose: Document corrected loaded-state alignment and held-C onset coverage at the peddler-side upper edge.
interpretation: The last useful held-C onset is c50: it still follows the ordinary jump arc and crosses the upper-edge geometry before descending. At c55 and later, the player has already entered the fall window, so C does not alter the route. All branches settle in the lower band with scene state 0x01.
conclusion: This closes the remaining C-onset timing variable for the stable peddler platform. The missing progression is not a peddler-side jump-timing response; the lower/far resource-object chain remains the higher-value target.
